Diabetic neuropathy pathogenesis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003Euncontrolled high blood sugar damages nerves and interferes with their ability to send signals\u003C\/b\u003E, leading to diabetic neuropathy.
